sloka: अजा बभूवुः धूम्राः च संगताः परमर्षयः ।तेषाम् दयाअर्थम् गरुडः ताम् शाखाम् शत योजनाम् ॥३-३५-३१॥
transliteration: ajā babhūvuḥ dhūmrāḥ ca saṁgatāḥ paramarṣayaḥ ।teṣām dayāartham garuḍaḥ tām śākhām śata yojanām ॥3-35-31॥

translations.english: Out of compassion for the (endangered) seers Garuda carried away that hundredyojanalong branch along with the elephant and the tortoise with great speed.
